# vendor

Packed builds of `@zaes/sidc` and `@zaes/military-symbols` (0.1.0), which the demo uses to draw the
centre symbol of Cover, Guard, Screen and the other graphics that carry one. They are installed as
dev dependencies from these files until the packages are published to npm; the library itself does
not depend on them.

To refresh them, run `npm pack` in each package of that repository and copy the `.tgz` files here.
